title: BIP delta, invalidation, and backpressure contract
description: Incremental page updates and the two ways a stream gives up honestly. Delta streams are an optimization: correctness can always fall back to a bounded fresh snapshot. Protocol specification section 10.

DeltaCategory.title: DeltaCategory
DeltaCategory.description: A class of change carried by a delta, used to say what backpressure dropped. Optional text and layout changes are dropped first; lifecycle and node-removal signals are dropped last, because losing them would leave a subscriber acting on a node that no longer exists. Closed enumeration: a consumer that receives a value outside this list MUST treat the message as unsupported and fail closed, and MUST NOT coerce the value to a known member (protocol section 6.2).

ChangedNode.title: ChangedNode
ChangedNode.description: A node in its new form, with the fields that changed named explicitly so a subscriber can decide whether the change matters to its task.

InvalidationReason.title: InvalidationReason
InvalidationReason.description: Why a projection must be thrown away. UNKNOWN_DELTA_FIELD is deliberately separate from the compatibility rule that accepts unknown optional fields on decode: decoding a minor-version message still succeeds, but a subscriber that cannot interpret a field inside a delta cannot prove its projection is still correct, so it resnapshots instead of guessing. FRAME_DETACHED is likewise separate from ENDPOINT_DISCONNECTED and RENDERER_CRASHED: a frame leaving the tree is ordinary lifecycle, and collapsing it into a lost-pipe reason would make a routine subframe navigation indistinguishable from a renderer that died. Closed enumeration: a consumer that receives a value outside this list MUST treat the message as unsupported and fail closed, and MUST NOT coerce the value to a known member (protocol section 6.2).

PageInvalidation.title: PageInvalidation
PageInvalidation.description: Notice that previously observed state can no longer be trusted. Navigation invalidation has priority over queued extraction and action work: a subscriber applies this before anything else it is holding.

retires_page_epoch.description: Whether the named epoch is retired outright. When true, every handle bound to it is dead and no refresh can revive it; a new binding is required.

invalidates_child_frames_only.description: Whether only the named frame's handles die. A parent handle survives a child-frame navigation unless the parent's own assumptions changed.

new_page_epoch.description: The replacement epoch, when the broker has already bound one. It is a fresh binding, never a continuation: no handle from the retired epoch becomes valid under it.

PageDelta.title: PageDelta
PageDelta.description: An incremental update to a subscriber's projection. A delta applies only when its page epoch, from-revision, and event sequence match what the subscriber currently holds. A gap, an overflow, an adapter restart, or a field the subscriber cannot interpret discards the projection and forces a fresh snapshot. The model is never called once per document mutation: task policy chooses the meaningful checkpoints.

coalesced_mutation_count.description: How many source mutations the adapter folded into this delta. Adapters may coalesce rapid mutations, but never across an action preflight and dispatch boundary in a way that hides a changed precondition.

removed_node_ids.description: Identifiers retired by this delta. A retired identifier is never reissued within its epoch, so a recycled virtualized row appears as a removal plus an addition rather than a change.

BackpressureAction.title: BackpressureAction
BackpressureAction.description: What the broker did to protect renderer and interface health before queue growth hurt them. Closed enumeration: a consumer that receives a value outside this list MUST treat the message as unsupported and fail closed, and MUST NOT coerce the value to a known member (protocol section 6.2).

BackpressureNotice.title: BackpressureNotice
BackpressureNotice.description: Honest notice that the stream could not keep up. Dropping updates silently would let a subscriber act on a stale projection, so the loss is always reported, always names which categories were dropped, and says whether a fresh snapshot is now required.

dropped_categories.description: Which categories were dropped, in drop order. A notice that lists NODE_REMOVED or LIFECYCLE always requires a fresh snapshot.
